title: Amazon RDS reports snapshot storage charges at per-snapshot granularity
description: Amazon RDS now attributes snapshot storage charges to each snapshot individually in AWS Cost Explorer and your AWS Cost and Usage Report. The ResourceId field shows the Amazon RDS snapshot ARN, or the Amazon RDS cluster snapshot ARN for Multi-AZ DB cluster snapshots. Your pricing and overall charges are unchanged. title: AWS IAM Identity Center's Identity Store now supports change notifications through Amazon EventBridge
description: AWS IAM Identity Center's Identity Store now delivers real-time events to Amazon EventBridge when users, groups, or group memberships or the identity store itself is created, updated, or deleted. title: Amazon Bedrock now offers Canada cross-Region inference for Claude Haiku 5.5
description:
Amazon Bedrock now offers Canada cross-Region inference (CRIS) for Anthropic's Claude Haiku 5.5. Customers with strict data residency requirements can now keep inference processing entirely within Canada. Canada CRIS routes requests only between ca-central-1 (Canada Central) and ca-west-1 (Canada West, Calgary). This helps organizations in financial services, healthcare, the public sector, and other regulated industries meet federal and provincial data residency requirements.
